name: Laundry basket
description: A blue plastic basket with slotted sides and a hand hole at each end.
notes: Drawn empty and open. The slots in the walls are the plastic's vents, not damage. The pocket grid is a placeholder.

name: Trash can
description: A round grey plastic bin with side grips and a black lid with a swing flap.
notes: Drawn with its lid on. Splitting under heavy loads has no content field yet. The pocket grid is a placeholder.

name: Wheelie bin
description: A green two-wheeled kerbside bin with a hinged lid and a grip bar for tipping it onto its wheels.
notes: Rolling it on its wheels rather than carrying it has no content field yet; it is still an item, not furniture. The pocket grid is a placeholder.

name: Large straw basket
description: A big round basket woven from straw, with a loop handle on each side.
notes: It is handmade, so it also has crafting origins; it keeps a residential loot tier as a household basket. No straw or wicker finish exists: wax-cream draws the straw body and wood-pine the darker woven bands, rim and handles. The pocket grid is a placeholder.

name: Garment bag
description: A zipped navy garment bag on a steel hanger hook, sized to keep one full change of clothes pressed and together.
notes: A store for one outfit that the wearer swaps into in a single action; swapping a whole outfit has no content field yet, so it is drafted as a plain container. Drawn as the garment bag a player would carry, lying flat, holding a full set of clothes. The pocket grid is a placeholder.

name: Latched plastic case
description: A small grey hard plastic case with a carry handle and four yellow snap latches holding its lid shut.
notes: Drawn empty and shut. Found in labs, hence the medical usage. The pocket grid is a placeholder.

name: Collapsible fuel drum
description: An emptied black rubber fuel drum pressed flat between its steel end fittings, with a valve, towing rings and a yellow flammable warning on top. It holds about 1,600 litres when filled.
notes: The id names what the drum holds, since a model id cannot start with a digit. Drawn empty and collapsed, the state it is moved in; a filled drum is a fixed tank, and filling it has no content field yet. The box counts the tapered ends, the towing rings and the valve standing above the 100 mm body. The stencil is a plain yellow panel rather than lettering. It is far too heavy to carry far, which the size already says.

name: Collapsible water drum
description: An emptied beige rubber water drum pressed flat between its steel end fittings, with a water valve, towing rings and a drinking-water-only stencil on top.
notes: The id names what the drum holds, since a model id cannot start with a digit. Drawn empty and collapsed; holding about 200 L of water has no content field yet. polymer-fde stands in for beige rubber, and the stencil is a plain dark panel rather than lettering.
